Hello Kunal ,

Glad to connect.

I am reaching out from Techdataseeders. Our Co-Founder & COO, Dakshesh Bhardwaj, will be at Cypher 2026 at KTPO, Bengaluru from 7th to 9th October, and we saw that you will be there too.

Why we would like to meet: whatever AI or analytics a company builds, it is only as good as the data behind it. A lot of that data is not inside the company. It is spread across thousands of public websites, apps and online platforms, in different formats, changing every day, and rarely available through a ready API.

That is what we do. Whatever your industry, we build automated pipelines that collect this data from the web and apps and deliver it clean and structured, through Excel, dashboards, API or directly into your AI systems. Once set up, it keeps running without your team having to touch it.

For teams we meet at Cypher, we are offering a free first batch of data, with no commitment. If it is useful, we can talk further. If not, you keep the data.

In 20 minutes, Dakshesh would like to understand what data your team needs, and tell you honestly whether and how we can help.

Would you have some time between 7th and 9th October? Just reply with a day and time that suits you

Looking forward to connecting

Thank you!

Karan
